## Context

- The `/task/new/` fixture intake surface was already retired by P34.12
  (route + lib + tests deleted, `AbsenceHatch` a named non-link). What
  remained overstating on `/map/` was the *vocabulary* and the legend: the
  tables said "devices"/"assets", every catalogued layer was listed whether
  or not the build carried records for it, and a value-suppressed bin
  printed its raw `deviceCount`. The K12b NEW-7 replacement is a
  per-jurisdiction **contested count** (`locationAbsence === "UNRESOLVED"`,
  §9.5 — the same absence the export emits for `point_status="conflicted"`)
  that leads to the jurisdiction dossier — but only when a dossier with the
  exporter-`_slugify`-mirrored slug exists, so a count never links a 404.
- The centrality statistic overstated twice over: the figures rested on
  organisation entities no resolution gate had blessed, and the inline
  disclosure claimed the endpoints were "minted by deterministic identity
  resolution … exact … never an estimate". D-K2-2 withdraws both — by
  **abstention**, not deletion: `analytics/web/centrality.json` still emits
  (schema unchanged) with `statistics: []` and the `focus` block kept as a
  *presentation mechanism* (the ego centre's stated pick rule — highest
  undirected degree, ties lexical). `CentralityStatistic`/`ErQuality` and
  their structural SIG-UI-023 disclosure contract stay in `network.ts` for
  the gate's return.
- `sig.workspace-state/1` parses `jurisdiction`/`source`/`technology`/
  `location` (and `q`/`kind`/`collection`/`page`) but no island applies all
  of them: the map applies `collection`/`focus`/`release`, the network
  `focus`/`release`, search `q`/`kind`/`focus` (+`release` on all three).
  The contract now reports *which* contract params were present
  (`WorkspaceParse.present`), `APPLIED_PARAMS` names what each view
  applies, and `unappliedParams` + `facetNoticeText` (copy row WS-01) give
  every island the same visible notice: an ignored facet never passes for a
  filter that held (SIG-UI-DV04's interim until UXR-10's applying filters).

## Plan

1. `web/src/lib/map.ts` — `layerControlsWithData`/`layersWithData` (legend
   entries exist only for layers with records), `binCountLabel` +
   `SUPPRESSED_COUNT_LABEL` (a value-suppressed bin prints the word, never
   the figure), `contestedCount` + `jurisdictionSlug` (the dossier lead).
2. `web/src/pages/map.astro` — "records" vocabulary throughout, data-filtered
   legend + observed/derived explainer, suppressed bins print the word,
   per-jurisdiction contested counts linking `/dossier/<slug>/` only when
   the dossier exists, intro rewritten (K1 NEW-20).
3. `web/src/lib/workspace-state.ts` + `web/src/islands/workspace.ts` —
   `present`, `APPLIED_PARAMS`, `unappliedParams`, `IGNORED_FACET_NOTICE`,
   `facetNoticeText`; the hook exposes `ignored` per view.
4. All three islands render `data-testid="facet-not-applied"` with the
   notice; `NetworkIsland` loses the `centrality` prop and all statistic
   rendering; `MapIsland`'s aria text says "records".
5. `exports/src/exports/analytics.py` — `statistics=[]`, `_ER_DISCLOSURE`
   and its "exact" claim removed; `focus` kept with its stated rule.
   `web/scripts/build-fixture-export.ts` mirrors it; the fixture drops
   `CENTRALITY_STATS`/`ER_QUALITY` and gains one `UNRESOLVED`-location
   record so the contested count is exercised.
6. `web/src/lib/data.ts` — `getNetworkCentrality()` removed;
   `getNetworkFocusEntityId()` keeps reading the artifact's `focus` block.
7. Copy: rows **MP-01…MP-15** (`/map/` + `lib/map.ts`), **NW-01…NW-03**
   (`/network/` + `lib/empty.ts`), **WS-01** (`lib/workspace-state.ts`) —
   appended `pending` to `batch-01.md` with sha256s; the P34.11 binding
   test extended (`MP|NW|WS` prefixes, `/map/` + `/network/` pages, three
   lib pages).
8. Tests: vitest additions (`map`, `workspace-state`, `network`, `data`),
   e2e updates (`map-network.{spec,nojs}`, `islands.spec`,
   `workspace.spec`), pytest `test_p34_15_island_honesty.py` (dead-link /
   withdrawn-claim / ignored-facet-link sweeps),
   `test_export_analytics.py` updated to the abstention contract.

## Gap review

- The ticket says "the 5,290 dead gap links" — the dead `/task/new/`
  surface itself was P34.12's retirement; what this row adds is the
  positive replacement (contested counts → dossier), plus a sweep that
  fails if any `/task/` link returns (`test_no_task_link_ever_returns`).
- `WorkspaceParse.present` reports presence separately from the parsed
  value so a malformed-but-named facet still announces (the malformed
  value itself stays in `issues` — visible twice, never silently once).
- `getDossiers()` is read defensively on the map page — a partial export
  tree without `dossiers.json` degrades to the count with no link rather
  than failing the build.
- The `centrality` empty-state surface in `empty.ts` is no longer
  rendered (the page abstains rather than stating emptiness); the copy
  stays — aligned to the abstention wording and pinned as NW-03.
- `page` is not applied by any island today (search caps at 100/group
  rather than paginating) — it is correctly announced when present.
